task_prompt: Generate the RGB video requested in `prompt.txt`, following `GENERATION_RULES.md` and `task_spec.json`. There is no input image. Choose your own approach. Visual image tools are available; choose whether to inspect your output.
rules:
# PixelWorld generation contract v2

- Use only `prompt.txt` and `task_spec.json`. Work inside this workspace. No network, other cases, reference continuations, masks, scores, memory, external AI models, learned weights, external simulation/rendering engines, or subagents.
- Generate 40 RGB frames at 256×144, 4 fps, for 10 seconds. Generate all frames from the text.
- Implement `generate.py` and call `artifact_io.save(frames, case_dir)` with uint8 RGB arrays of shape `(40,144,256,3)`. Local Python/numpy/PIL, mathematical geometry, motion, lighting, copying and warping pixels are allowed.
- Also generate 240000 PCM samples at 24000 Hz, 1 channel(s), synchronized to the RGB video; pass `audio=` (int16 shape `(240000,1)`) to `artifact_io.save`.
- Save intermediate generated results in the workspace when producing candidates for inspection. Choose whether and how to check or revise your output.
